summary.name: KeeWeb
summary.one_liner: KeeWeb is a free, open-source password manager compatible with KeePass databases, available as desktop apps and a web app.
use_cases: store and manage passwords in a KeePass-compatible database
access passwords from a web browser without installing anything
sync a password file across devices via Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive
generate strong passwords with custom length and symbols
view and copy passwords from a mobile browser
summary.what_it_does: KeeWeb is a password manager compatible with KeePass that runs as desktop apps on macOS, Windows and Linux, and as a web version that needs no installation in modern browsers. It can open local files or files stored in Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or a personal server, syncing changes automatically and keeping offline copies. Users can search across multiple open files from one search box, use tags and colors to organize entries, and attach files or images. The app also includes a password generator with selectable symbols, a change history with rollback, and hidden fields stored in memory more securely. The source code is on GitHub and can be built from source.
notable: Open source with source code on GitHub, buildable from source
Web version works in browsers without installation
Syncs KeePass files with Dropbox, Google Drive, OneDrive or own server
Full change history with rollback to any earlier state
caveats: Mobile use is through a mobile browser; no native mobile app is mentioned on the page
Web version has almost all features of the desktop apps, not all
